summary: Tested RDS Builder Custom Text input and Stream Monitor VU meters/playback. RDS Builder custom text is WORKING correctly. Stream Monitor audio playback NOT working - audio element stays in loading state (readyState=0) despite backend proxy returning valid audio data.

integration_issues.issue: Audio element never loads data from proxied stream - readyState stays at 0, networkState=2 (LOADING) indefinitely. Backend proxy returns valid audio/aacp data but browser audio element cannot decode it.
VU meters don't animate because audio never actually plays - this is a consequence of the audio loading issue above

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix Stream Monitor audio playback - The proxied audio stream is not being decoded by the browser's audio element. The backend proxy returns valid audio data (verified via curl), but the HTML5 audio element never transitions from readyState=0.

Possible solutions: 1) Use direct stream URLs with CORS (they have Access-Control-Allow-Origin:*), 2) Fix proxy response format/headers for ICY/Shoutcast streams, 3) Consider using a different streaming approach like MSE (Media Source Extensions)
critical_code_review_comments: RDS Builder Custom Text input fix is WORKING - e.stopPropagation() and data-testid attributes correctly applied
Stream proxy backend is working correctly - returns valid audio/aacp data with proper CORS headers
Issue is in how browser audio element handles the proxied stream - likely ICY protocol headers being stripped

success_rate.backend: 100% (stream proxy returns data, RDS builder API works)
success_rate.frontend: 50% (RDS Builder works, Stream Monitor audio NOT working)

context_for_next_testing_agent: RDS Builder custom text input is working correctly after main agent's fix. Stream Monitor has a deeper issue - the audio proxy backend works and returns valid audio data, but the browser audio element cannot decode it. The issue might be related to ICY/Shoutcast protocol headers being stripped by the proxy, or the chunked transfer encoding not being compatible with HTML5 audio element. Original streams have CORS headers set, so direct access might be an alternative.

RDS Builder Custom Text.details: Typing in custom text input works, text is saved to backend API correctly

Stream Proxy Backend.details: Returns valid audio/aacp data with CORS headers

Stream Monitor UI.details: Page loads correctly, shows 3 stream players with play buttons and VU meters

Stream Monitor Audio Playback.details: Audio element never loads data - readyState stays at 0

VU Meters Animation.details: VU meters don't show levels because audio never plays

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: The proxied audio stream is not being properly decoded by the browser's HTML5 audio element. The readyState stays at 0 (HAVE_NOTHING) even though networkState is 2 (NETWORK_LOADING) and backend returns valid audio data. This suggests the browser cannot parse the streaming response format.
investigation_done: Verified backend proxy returns valid audio data via curl
Verified original streams have CORS enabled
Tested with different Content-Type headers (audio/aac, audio/aacp)
Confirmed audio element 'paused: false' but no data loading
potential_fixes: Use direct stream URLs instead of proxy (they already have CORS)
Implement proper ICY protocol header forwarding in proxy
Use Media Source Extensions (MSE) instead of HTML5 audio element
Consider using a WebSocket-based audio streaming approach
